guide_help_title: When to get help in person
guide_help_critical: This one is safety-critical or emotion-driven. Work with a qualified force-free trainer or a veterinary behaviourist rather than doing it alone.
guide_help_text: Pawty is educational content, not veterinary or behavioural advice.
guide_help_common: See a veterinarian for any sudden behaviour change or sign of pain, and a qualified behaviourist in person if your dog has bitten, guards with snapping, or panics when left alone. Read our approach.
guide_cta_title: Train it, do not just read about it
guide_cta_text: Pawty also has 99 training skills in 3-minute sessions you rate 1 to 5 paws, streaks that freeze instead of reset, and a care calendar. Free. No subscription, no paywall.
